findings.finding: With the same standard mode/seed, expanded-catalog combined action view measured 3.552994 ms and 6583333.92 allocated bytes per call; base-catalog view measured 0.969335 ms and 1859968.34 bytes. Expanded catalog contains 676 skills and 357 generals. This compares catalog sizes at the current revision, not historical regressions.
findings.recommendation: Profile and reduce repeated context/projection allocations in the action-query path. Empty binding fast paths and catalog capability indexes are candidates; causal method-level attribution was not measured. Preserve all viewer, commit, and skill-lifetime boundaries.

findings.finding: Core full execution took 609944 ms. 15 cases exceeded 5 seconds. Slowest passing cases were Wu Xian Borrowed Sword 26588.786 ms and public pile store/exchange/distribute 21100.741 ms. Both repeatedly restore complete command prefixes and check multiple branches.

findings.finding: Expanded catalog construction measured 11.60832 ms and 8821104.11 allocated bytes per call. Repeated registry construction can amplify test/setup costs.
